title: Genistein attenuates memory impairment in Alzheimer's disease via ERS-mediated apoptotic pathway in vivo and in vitro.
authors: Gao, Huawu; Lei, Xin; Ye, Shu; Ye, Ting; Hua, Rupeng; Wang, Guoquan; Song, Hang; Zhou, Peng; Wang, Yan; Cai, Biao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金雀异黄酮通过ERS介导凋亡通路改善阿尔茨海默病记忆障碍，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合预测，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Genistein (GS), an isoflavone compound found in soybean, plays a neuroprotective role in Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, the mechanism of its action remains unclear. Herein, binding ability between GS and GRP78 was predicted by molecular docking, and the effect of GS in vivo and vitro were further studied. In this study, the effects of GS on learning and memory ability, changes of hippocampal neurons and ultrastructure of hippocampal CA3 region in AD rats were investigated. Besides, the protein or mRNA levels of the related proteins were detected. The results showed GS could effectively improve the learning and the memory ability, reduce the damage of hippocampal neurons, and decrease the protein or mRNA expression levels of GRP78, CHOP, Caspase-12, Cle-Caspase-9, Cle-Caspase-3, PERK, and p-PERK. Taken together, our data reveal GS has a neuroprotective effect by inhibiting the ERS-mediated apoptotic pathway, which may be a new therapeutic target for the treatment of AD.
abstract_zh: 染料木黄酮（Genistein, GS）是一种存在于大豆中的异黄酮类化合物，在阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）中发挥神经保护作用。然而，其作用机制尚不清楚。本研究通过分子对接预测了GS与GRP78之间的结合能力，并进一步研究了GS在体内和体外的作用。实验中，我们观察了GS对AD大鼠学习记忆能力、海马神经元变化及海马CA3区超微结构的影响。此外，还检测了相关蛋白的蛋白或mRNA水平。结果显示，GS能有效改善学习记忆能力，减轻海马神经元损伤，并降低GRP78、CHOP、Caspase-12、Cle-Caspase-9、Cle-Caspase-3、PERK及p-PERK的蛋白或mRNA表达水平。综上所述，我们的数据表明GS通过抑制内质网应激（ERS）介导的凋亡通路发挥神经保护作用，这可能成为治疗AD的新靶点。
